title: Brand Communications & Activation Manager
description:
We're partnering with a leading premium consumer brand to recruit a Brand Communications & Activation Manager. This is a unique opportunity to join a collaborative marketing team in a newly created role that sits at the heart of brand, communications, digital and shopper activation.

Client Details

You'll have the opportunity to work across well-loved consumer brands, partnering closely with Digital, Commercial and Marketing teams to bring campaigns and communications to life.

Description

Reporting into the Head of Marketing, you'll be responsible for translating brand strategies into compelling consumer communications and activation programmes.

Acting as the bridge between brand, digital and commercial teams, you'll drive projects forward, manage communications activity and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively across the consumer journey.

Key responsibilities include:
- Developing and executing brand communication plans
- Creating compelling consumer-facing content and messaging
- Managing website copy and product content
- Leading photography and content creation projects
- Driving shopper marketing and retail activation initiatives
- Briefing and coordinating internal and external stakeholders
- Working closely with digital marketing teams to bring campaigns to life
- Managing multiple projects simultaneously and ensuring delivery against deadlines
- Supporting the creation of engaging consumer experiences across digital and retail channels

Profile

You'll likely bring:
- Experience developing consumer-facing communications
- Strong project management and organisational skills
- Experience working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders
- Excellent written communication and copywriting abilities
- Experience delivering activation, campaign or shopper marketing initiatives
- A commercial mindset and strong attention to detail
- The ability to influence, coordinate and drive projects forward

Job Offer

This is an exciting opportunity to step into a highly visible role with genuine breadth, combining communications, content, activation and project leadership. Hybrid working 2 days in the office.

title: Brand Manager
description:
As a Brand Manager, you'll lead the marketing strategy and growth, taking ownership of integrated campaigns, innovation, digital growth and product launches within a fast-growing category. Working cross-functionally with sales, digital, innovation and agency partners, you'll drive brand performance and deliver commercially impactful marketing programmes across the UK and international markets.

Client Details

Our client is a dynamic consumer healthcare company in Berkshire with a growing portfolio of market-leading brands. Known for its innovative culture and strong focus on health, the business offers the opportunity to make a visible impact within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Description

Brand Strategy & Planning:

Developing and delivering the brand strategy and annual marketing plans,

ensuring all activity supports business objectives and maintains consistent brand positioning,

messaging and tone of voice.

Trade Marketing & Retail Activation:

Supporting the Commercial team with compelling trade presentations, category stories and

retailer sell-in materials. Using shopper and category insight to optimise distribution, visibility

and point-of-sale activity across key retail partners.

Integrated Campaign Management:

Leading the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned

channels. Working with internal teams and external agencies to ensure activity is joined up,

efficient and commercially effective.

Consumer Engagement & DTC Growth:

Working closely with the Digital Lead to drive DTC growth through effective customer

journeys, stronger consumer engagement and high-performing content. Using data and insight

to identify winning content, optimise performance and improve conversion across digital

channels.

Innovation & Product Development:

Partnering with the Innovation team to identify opportunities for product extensions, new

formats and breakthrough innovation that support the long-term growth.

Product Launches:

Working with the Commercial and Innovation teams to develop and deliver impactful launch

plans across the UK and international markets. Build awareness, engagement and retailer

support through creative, commercially effective campaigns.

Budget Management:

Managing the annual brand budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across

channels and campaigns. Monitoring expenditure, evaluate return on investment and optimise

spend to achieve business objectives.

Performance Analysis & Optimisation:

Tracking brand performance using sales, market share, digital, brand health and retail metrics.

Turning insight into practical recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and

business performance.

Consumer, Category & Competitor Insights:

Working closely with Category, Insights and Research teams to identify market trends,

evolving consumer needs and competitor activity. Use these insights to shape strategy, unlock

growth opportunities and maintain a strong market position.

Profile

A successful Brand Manager should have:
- A strong track record of delivering growth, preferably for consumer healthcare, medical device, OTC, wellness or personal care brands, including omnichannel campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and sales.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, DTC growth and customer journey development. Experience working with digital specialists and using data to improve consumer acquisition, engagement and conversion.
- Comfortable using analytics tools to track performance (e.g., EPOS, Google Analytics, Nielsen, continuous brand tracking data) and can adjust tactics based on what the data shows to optimise results.
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams, brief agencies clearly and build string internal and external relationships.
- An analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable insights.
- A self-starter who is comfortable working at pace, taking ownership and balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery.
- Excellent attention to detail across planning, delivering and evaluation ensuring consistency in brand messaging, creative quality and regulatory compliance.
- Good understanding of medical device , healthcare and cosmetic regulations and evidence-based claims, with the ability to translate regulatory and scientific requirements into clear, compelling and compliant brand consumer communications.
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field is preferred (or equivalent work experience).
- Professional marketing qualifications (e.g., CIM certification) are desirable.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary
- Permanent position based in Berkshire
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Graduate Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Graduate - AI & Digital

Full Time Permanent

We're looking for a Marketing or Software Engineering graduate who is digitally minded, AI-focused and keen to build a career in B2 B marketing.

You'll work across a varied marketing function, gaining experience in content, campaigns, digital, social media, data, lead generation and AI automation.

Key Responsibilities
- Use AI tools to research markets, competitors, target accounts and prospects.
- Support prospecting, outbound campaigns, lead nurturing and account-based marketing.
- Create and repurpose content including social posts, emails, blogs, guides and case studies.
- Support website updates, SEO, paid search, paid social and email campaigns.
- Plan and report on social media activity.
- Assist with campaigns, webinars, events, trade shows and partner marketing.
- Maintain Salesforce data and support campaign tracking and reporting.
- Research customer, competitor, energy market and sustainability information.
- Test AI tools and create simple automations, workflows and prompt libraries.
- Support internal communications, sales enablement, marketing administration, budgets and suppliers.

About You
- Degree in Marketing or Software Engineering with an interest in marketing/growth, digital, data or business, or equivalent experience.
- Confident using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Perplexity.
- Tech-savvy with an interest in learning platforms including Salesforce and LinkedIn.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Organised, curious, proactive and willing to get involved.
- Interested in learning how marketing supports business growth and sales.

Apply now!

title: Marketing & Graphic Design Executive
description:
Marketing & Design Executive
Langley, Berkshire Full-time Office-based
Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a strong marketing mindset who enjoys getting stuck into a wide variety of creative projects?
An ambitious and growing UK product-led brand is looking for a Marketing & Design Executive to join its in-house team and take ownership of a broad range of creative and marketing activity.
This is a genuinely hands-on role where you ll be responsible for producing high-quality work across print, digital, website content, product communications, point-of-sale and advertising.
The Role
Working closely with management, sales and product teams, you ll help ensure the brand is presented consistently, professionally and creatively across every customer touchpoint.
No two days will be the same. You could be:
- Designing a brochure or promotional campaign
- Creating artwork for billboards and outdoor advertising
- Producing digital assets for websites, email campaigns and online advertising
- Updating product ranges and content on the website
- Creating technical specification sheets and product literature
- Preparing artwork for print and external suppliers
- Supporting new product and range launches
- Editing and preparing product photography
- Creating sales presentations and marketing materials
- Supporting exhibitions, showroom events and customer activity
- Working with external agencies, photographers, printers and suppliers

You ll have genuine ownership of the day-to-day creative output and the opportunity to make a visible impact on how the brand develops and grows.
About You
We re looking for someone who combines strong graphic design skills with excellent organisation, attention to detail and commercial awareness.
You ll ideally have:
- Strong graphic design skills and an impressive portfolio
- Excellent knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop
- Experience producing print-ready artwork
- Experience managing and updating website content
- Experience creating brochures, catalogues or technical/product literature
- Good knowledge of image editing and preparation for web and print
- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly with product codes, measurements and technical information
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once
- Excellent written English and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and take projects from brief through to completion

Experience within an in-house design/marketing team, creative agency or product-led business would be beneficial.
What s On Offer
This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious, growing business with a strong focus on product design, innovation and colour.
You ll have the opportunity to become an important part of the in-house team, with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
Rather than being restricted to one area of marketing, you ll work across the full creative spectrum from new product launches and technical literature to brochures, websites and national advertising campaigns.
If you re a creative, commercially minded designer who enjoys variety, works quickly and accurately, and takes real pride in how a brand looks and communicates, we d love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Administrator
description:
Marketing Administrator

This is a great opportunity to join a fast-growing property development business to support their marketing activities and be part of a marketing team in Reading.

You'll support every part of the marketing function, from new development launches to resident events. You'll work closely with the marketing team, Lettings teams and external suppliers.

The role:
- Manage property listings on Rightmove, Zoopla and OnTheMarket so they're accurate and compliant
- Update website content, including availability, photos, floorplans and local area pages
- Raise purchase orders, reconcile invoices and keep budget trackers up to date
- Look after the marketing inbox, the CRM and the image and video libraries
- Help run campaigns, launch events and resident community activities
- Research competitors, local schools, transport links and amenities, and help with campaign reporting

Skills & Experience Required:
- A degree in Marketing or equivalent would be ideal
- Experience of the property sector and property websites would be a huge advantage
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail
- A confident communicator in writing and in person
- Comfortable with Microsoft Office, data and digital platforms
- Proactive, able to solve problems and happy juggling several priorities at a fast pace
- Interested in marketing, customer experience and property

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Are you an organised, creative and detail-focused Marketing Assistant looking for an opportunity to develop your career within a fast-paced international business?
We are working with a leading global organisation operating across the technology and consumer products sector who are looking for a Marketing Assistant to join their European marketing team.
This is a varied role offering exposure to multiple areas of the marketing mix, working closely with brand, digital, content, product management and external agency teams.
The Role As Marketing Assistant, you will support the delivery of marketing activity across multiple channels, helping to create engaging content and ensuring marketing materials are delivered accurately, on time and in line with brand guidelines.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and delivering marketing materials across multiple channels
- Supporting point-of-sale, merchandising, in-store campaigns, print literature and press releases
- Supporting the creation of video and photography assets
- Helping to brief projects and review storyboards
- Attending and supporting production shoots where required
- Managing and maintaining the marketing image library
- Updating marketing assets for local use and website integration
- Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and category marketing activity
- Working with product management and local marketing teams to develop compelling marketing content
- Collaborating with brand marketing, digital and content teams
- Working with external suppliers and key distributors across Europe
- Supporting social media content creation and management
- Ensuring all marketing materials are accurate, consistent and aligned with brand guidelines
- Managing multiple projects and prioritising workloads to meet deadlines

About You We're looking for someone who is creative, organised and commercially aware, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects at once.
You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing assistant, marketing coordinator or similar role
- A genuine interest in marketing and content creation
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Exceptional attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
- A creative mindset and an interest in developing engaging marketing content
- Strong interpersonal skills and confidence working with different stakeholders
- The ability to work collaboratively while also being comfortable working independently
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel
- Good analytical and numerical skills
- A university degree would be advantageous
- Additional European language skills would be desirable
- Flexibility and willingness to undertake European and long-haul travel

The Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional to join a successful international organisation and gain broad exposure across brand marketing, digital, content, social media, product marketing and NPI.

You will work with teams and external partners across Europe, giving you the opportunity to develop your marketing career within a genuinely international environment.

If you're creative, highly organised and looking for a role where you can make a real contribution across a broad marketing mix, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Brand Manager
company: WALKER COLE INTERNATIONAL LTD - Company - Permanent
description:
Senior Brand Manager

Walker Cole International is exclusively partnered with a leading European consumer healthcare company based in Reading. They are searching for a Senior Brand Manager to shape and deliver the long-term strategy for a portfolio of established OTC brands; owning the P&L, leading 360 activation and driving innovation at a time of accelerated growth and portfolio expansion. This is a hybrid role, with three days per week in the Reading office.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Leading long-term brand strategies and annual brand plans, and owning the full activation roadmap across ATL, BTL, digital, PR, shopper and e-commerce.
- Holding full accountability for the brand P&L and A&P budget, leading performance reviews and turning data into clear strategic recommendations.
- Shaping the innovation pipeline and overseeing NPD/EPD projects from concept and business case through to launch, in partnership with global teams.
- Acting as senior project lead across Sales, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Finance and agencies, while coaching and developing Brand Managers.

To be considered for this opportunity, you should possess:
- 4+ years' brand management experience within FMCG or Consumer Healthcare, with proven 360 brand-building and NPD launch capability.
- Demonstrable commercial acumen, including P&L ownership and strong analytical skills across insight, digital and performance data.
- The ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams, with a creative, entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset.

Brand Management Senior Brand Manager Marketing Consumer Healthcare OTC FMCG P&L 360 Marketing NPD Innovation Brand Strategy

title: Senior Social Media Executive
description:
Our client is a growing company working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. They are seeking a Senior Social Media Executive to join their team, taking ownership of social media planning, content delivery and performance across a range of client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced social media professional looking to take on greater responsibility, contribute strategically to campaigns and support the development of more junior team members.

Company Benefits:
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional birthday day off when it falls on a weekday.
- Discretionary annual bonus.
- Benefits package including employer pension contributions and healthcare.
- Professional development support and training budget.
- Friendly and collaborative team environment with regular social events.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- Flexibility around appointments and occasional personal commitments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing social media activity across a portfolio of client accounts from planning through to delivery and optimisation.
- Developing content plans and campaigns aligned with client objectives and wider marketing strategies.
- Creating engaging social media content, including copywriting, content ideation and campaign planning across multiple platforms.
- Briefing creative teams and coordinating the production of social-first content.
- Managing content scheduling, publishing and ongoing account activity.
- Acting as a day-to-day point of contact for clients, providing recommendations, updates and campaign insights.
- Analysing performance data and producing actionable recommendations to improve results.
- Monitoring trends, platform developments and audience insights to identify new opportunities.
- Managing community engagement and ensuring all interactions align with brand tone of voice and client expectations.
- Coordinating content shoots, campaign activity and social media coverage for events where required.
- Supporting and mentoring junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practice.
- Collaborating with wider creative, marketing and account management teams to deliver integrated campaigns.

Experience and Skills Requirements
- Minimum of 3 years' experience in social media, digital marketing or content marketing, with experience managing multiple accounts and delivering campaigns independently.
- Strong copywriting, content creation and social media strategy skills, with experience using scheduling, management and analytics tools.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills, with the ability to analyse performance data, manage multiple deadlines and mentor junior team members.
- Proactive, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine enthusiasm for social media, digital trends and platform innovation.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

Our client is a growing and ambitious company working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. They are seeking a creative and organised Social Media Executive to join their team, taking ownership of day-to-day social media activity across a range of client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys content creation, community management and using data to drive performance.

Company Benefits:
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional birthday day off when it falls on a weekday.
- Discretionary annual bonus.
- Benefits package including employer pension contributions and healthcare.
- Professional development support and training budget.
- Friendly and collaborative team environment with regular social events.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- Flexibility around appointments and occasional personal commitments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing day-to-day social media activity across a portfolio of client accounts.
- Creating and implementing content calendars aligned to client objectives and campaign strategies.
- Writing engaging social media copy and coordinating the creation of visual content across multiple platforms.
- Scheduling and publishing content while ensuring brand consistency and platform best practice.

- Monitoring audience feedback, identifying trends and escalating sensitive issues where required.
- Producing performance reports and providing actionable insights to improve content effectiveness.

- Supporting client communications, content approvals and campaign delivery.
- Coordinating content creation, photography and video requirements where necessary.
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure social media activity is integrated into wider marketing initiatives.
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging opportunities.

Experience and Skills Requirements

- Strong copywriting skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience managing multiple social media accounts and content calendars.
- Good understanding of major social media platforms and best practices.
- Experience using social media scheduling, management and reporting tools.
- Ability to interpret data and translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Creative, proactive and commercially aware approach.
- Genuine enthusiasm for social media, digital marketing and industry trends.

title: E-Commerce & Merchandising Executive
description:
My well established, dynamic Client is urgently looking for an organised, commercially minded E-Commerce and Merchandising Executive to improve the quality, accuracy and performance of their extensive ecommerce product catalogue.

Managing over 13,000 online SKUs across seven main product categories, alongside more than 20,000 offline products, the chosen Candidate will play a key role in improving product data, online merchandising, customer experience and catalogue management processes.

Working closely with Product Management, Pricing, Development, Content, Marketing and Analytics teams, you will lead agreed projects, improve workflows and use data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities
- Maintain accurate, complete and consistent product information across our ecommerce catalogue.
- Improve product categorisation, search, filters and online product presentation.
- Manage product launches, supplier changes, discontinuations and approved pricing updates.
- Use analytics and customer insights to improve product discovery and purchasing journeys.
- Plan and deliver projects, maintaining a prioritised Jira backlog and coordinating stakeholders.
- Establish quality checks for product updates, imports and website releases.
- Improve efficiency through Excel, PIM tools, automation and AI.
- Monitor catalogue performance and recommend improvements based on data and commercial objectives.

Essential experience:
- Experience managing and improving a large ecommerce product catalogue.
- Practical knowledge of PIM and ecommerce platforms, product feeds and bulk data updates.
- Strong Excel skills, including lookups, PivotTables and Power Query.
- Experience delivering cross-functional projects and improving processes.
- Ability to use analytics to improve product merchandising and customer experience.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and communication skills.

Systems and technology

The key platforms include Sales Layer, Feed Optimise, PriceShape, Microsoft Excel, Jira, Adobe Commerce, Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity. Experience with equivalent systems is welcome.

What success looks like

In your first six months, you will establish a catalogue quality baseline, resolve priority data issues, improve processes and deliver a practical roadmap for ongoing improvements.

Performance will be measured through catalogue accuracy and completeness, update turnaround times, delivery reliability and shared commercial measures such as conversion and average order value.

The opportunity

This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to take ownership of projects, introduce new technologies and make a measurable difference to our ecommerce operations. You will work collaboratively across the business, reporting initially to the Director of Digital & Technology.

Please send an up to date CV for an immediate response and more information on a fantastic opportunity with a truly great Client.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
McBride Sport is delighted to be partnering with one of the UK's leading sports, entertainment, and leisure organisations to appoint a Marketing Manager. The group operates a portfolio of high-profile venues across the country. Each one stages live sporting action throughout the year alongside a busy calendar of concerts, conferences, hospitality, and private events. This is a chance to take the lead on marketing across a number of venues in the South and South-East. You'll shape and deliver the marketing vision, creating bold, revenue-generating campaigns that make a real commercial impact. That means driving ticket sales, hospitality and corporate bookings, and income from non-event-day activity, while raising the profile of every venue in the region.

Day to day, you'll turn central and local strategy into campaigns that perform. You'll plan and book media, brief internal designers from concept through to delivery, and create engaging written, video and photo content for websites, email and social channels. You'll also work with the group's SEO and social media specialists to optimise digital performance, manage online reputation and customer feedback, and use campaign analysis to keep improving results. You'll line-manage the regional marketing team and own the regional budget, so a blend of creative thinking and sharp commercial focus is essential. What we're looking for:
- A strong B2 C background, ideally within leisure, hospitality, sport or live events
- Hands-on experience across on- and offline campaigns, social media, CRM and CMS platforms
- At least four years' experience in a similar marketing role, with line management and budget responsibility
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the organisation to deliver under pressure

You'll be a creative, results-driven self-starter who enjoys the pace of a live events environment. Previous experience in the events or leisure (B2 C) industry, and a marketing qualification would be an advantage. If you're ready to make your mark in an exciting and fast-moving industry, we'd love to hear from you.
